newsitem.title: UK: Rugby union-Ireland prop suspended 30 days.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Ireland prop suspended 30 days.

text.p: Nick Popplewell, the Newcastle and Ireland prop, was banned for 30 days by the Rugby Football Union on Monday for punching Bedford's Scott Murray in the face during a club match on April 5.
The former British Lion was found guilty by an RFU disciplinary committee after they viewed video evidence of the assault. Murray needed five stitches above his left eye.
Popplewell will serve the first 23 days of the suspension immediately and complete the remaining seven days at the start of next season.
